title: Huckleberry Sleep Log Sleep Hours Leaderboard
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=huckleberry:sleep total_sleep_hours=*
| stats sum(total_sleep_hours) as total_value, avg(total_sleep_hours) as avg_value by child_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks child values by total and average sleep hours across Huckleberry sleep log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `total_sleep_hours` values for each Huckleberry sleep log event and review total and average sleep hours by child.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total sleep hours.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which child shows the biggest sleep hours numbers in your Huckleberry sleep log data.
